purpose: Replace benchmark-visible stock Cube balcony guard members with a dimensioned, manufactured vertical-lattice guardrail while preserving the legacy Unity collider envelope as gameplay compatibility data. This is source-side construction readiness only; it awards no Visual Fidelity points without native 4K evidence.

referenceBasis.source: LIXIL/TOSTEM product chronology and current archive for ベランダ手すりⅡ
referenceBasis.factUsed: The series is documented as sold from 1996-10 and includes vertical-lattice configurations with top/lower horizontal members and repeated slender vertical members.
referenceBasis.useLimit: Used only to establish period-plausible product family and assembly logic around 2000; this generated fallback is not claimed to reproduce a specific TOSTEM SKU or proprietary section dimension.

referenceBasis.source: Japan MLIT child-fall-prevention housing evaluation guidance
referenceBasis.factUsed: A balcony fall-prevention reference condition uses 1100 mm floor-to-top height and 110 mm maximum clear dimension between vertical guard members.
referenceBasis.useLimit: Used as a conservative safety/plausibility datum for the generated fallback, not as a claim that every circa-2000 balcony used these exact members.

components: seven primary 40 x 40 mm support posts aligned with existing floor base plates
twenty-two 18 x 20 mm vertical infill bars between/around primary posts
existing physically seated lower rail retained as the lower capture member
small top/post and lower/post insertion sleeves visible only at close LOD
existing base plates and anchor heads retained as the slab attachment interface
manufacture.process: Factory-cut extrusions are assembled into repeated vertical-lattice panels. Primary posts transfer load into existing base plates/anchors; infill bars are captured by horizontal rails and do not pretend to be free-standing rods.
manufacture.geometryVsMaterial: Top rail section, posts, infill bars, capture overlap, base attachment and silhouette are geometry. Extrusion grain, oxidation haze, fine scratches, UV dulling and rain residue are material/microdetail. Lighting/highlights may never be painted into albedo.

materials.finish: weathered clear/silver anodized aluminum represented as a dielectric oxide-coated surface approximation in Unity Standard
materials.microstructure: deterministic 256 px extrusion/scuff normal, 0.08 m physical tile, mipmapped/trilinear/aniso 8; per-bay phase offset prevents all thirty manufactured modules from restarting the same micro-pattern
materials.wetness: 0.0 in the benchmark dry midsummer state; old rain streaking may alter roughness/residue locally but not create a current wet sheen
materials.uvAging: slight upper/exterior-face dulling consistent with long exterior exposure; no random damage mask
materials.angularFresnel: rough dielectric-coating grazing response from PBR/shading only; no painted highlight or impossible mirror-metal flash

mounting.loadPath: top rail/infill wind and occupant load -> seven primary posts -> existing seated base plates -> anchor heads/slab
mounting.primaryPostAlignment: Primary post centers remain at bay-local x = -1.44, -0.96, -0.48, 0, 0.48, 0.96, 1.44 m, exactly above the seven existing base-plate centers.
mounting.infillLayout: Twenty-nine vertical centerlines span x=-1.68..+1.68 m at 0.12 m pitch; the seven 0.48 m-grid positions are primary posts and the remaining twenty-two are infill bars.
mounting.legacyCompatibility: The original RailTop_* and Rail_* GameObjects/BoxColliders remain as named gameplay anchors. Their render meshes are reconstructed and their transforms may move for visual correctness only while BoxCollider world center/size are compensated to the original fallback envelope.

interfacesGapsSeals.topRail: Primary posts/infill terminate 5 mm into the top-rail underside capture zone; visible positive air gaps are forbidden.
interfacesGapsSeals.lowerRail: Infill bars terminate 5 mm into the already-corrected lower rail. The existing lower-rail underside remains 70 mm above the balcony finished floor.
interfacesGapsSeals.openingRule: Maximum horizontal clear opening between vertical members is 102 mm; any source calculation above 110 mm is FAIL.
interfacesGapsSeals.base: Primary posts penetrate 40 mm below finished-floor datum and remain centered over existing base plates; base plates/anchor heads continue to be governed by balcony_construction_interface_contract.json.
interfacesGapsSeals.seals: No elastomeric seal is invented between exposed railing extrusions; close joints are mechanical insertion/welded/fixed interfaces.

orientationExposure.orientation: Front balcony guard is fully exterior, rain/sun exposed; inner faces behind posts are more sheltered.
orientationExposure.sun: All rail highlights and post edge gradients must agree with the same coherent midsummer Japanese sun used by facade/shadow QA.
orientationExposure.rain: Top rail and outer vertical faces receive direct rain/UV; sheltered lower interfaces can retain slightly higher residue/roughness.
orientationExposure.contact: Hand-contact polishing may subtly lower roughness on the top rail only; it cannot be represented as a bright painted stripe.

aging.causality: Weathering intensity follows face exposure, drainage and contact; manufactured spacing/section remains regular.

lodPolicy.lod0: Chamfered top/post/infill geometry plus close-range insertion sleeves; legacy named top/post renderers are retained as LOD0 construction datums after their primitive meshes are replaced.
lodPolicy.lod1: Single combined chamfered proxy preserves top rail, all seven posts and all twenty-two infill bars; sleeves are removed.
lodPolicy.lod2: Single combined non-primitive box proxy preserves every vertical centerline and exact macro bounds with reduced edge complexity.
lodPolicy.lod3: Top rail and seven supports remain closed box geometry; all twenty-two infill centerlines remain as crossed thin long-distance proxies so guard density does not collapse into a visibly different pattern.
lodPolicy.hardRule: All four LODs preserve 1.10 m guard top and the same 3.55 m span; macro bounds may drift by at most 10 mm. Source triangle count must decrease LOD0 > LOD1 > LOD2 > LOD3. Visible pop/shimmer remains a rendered temporal critical check.

qaRules.renderVerification: PENDING until Unity 6000.3.0f1 produces native 3840x2160 hero/oblique/grazing frames, 100% crops and bound temporal evidence

renderEvidencePlan.hero: Verify the old seven widely spaced Cube bars no longer read as the complete guard; confirm a dense vertical-lattice silhouette and 1.10 m proportion against doors/windows/balcony depth.
renderEvidencePlan.oblique: At 100% crop verify top-rail depth/chamfers, all post-to-base alignments, lower capture, no floating/interpenetrating members and no coplanar duplicate rail geometry.
renderEvidencePlan.grazing: Verify anodized aluminum behaves as a rough dielectric-coated surface with real edge highlights from geometry/PBR, not painted light; repeated micro-normal phase must not be obvious.
renderEvidencePlan.temporal: Verify all four LODs retain the same guard density/span/height without bar disappearance, shimmer, severe aliasing or visible pop.

expectedVisualScoreImpact.geometryConstruction: Potentially removes a benchmark-visible primitive/under-populated railing deduction and corrects the floor-to-guard proportion plus real support/infill load path.
expectedVisualScoreImpact.materialPbr: Potentially replaces generic metal response with restrained anodized dielectric-coated behavior and manufacture-scale micro-normal.
expectedVisualScoreImpact.periodAuthenticity: Vertical-lattice aluminum balcony guard product families are documented in the 1996+ period, supporting a circa-2000 scene without claiming an exact SKU.
expectedVisualScoreImpact.temporalLod: Four explicit cross-faded levels retain all vertical centerlines instead of allowing the railing pattern to collapse at distance.

visualCreditPolicy.reason: Construction/math/metadata can reduce risk but cannot prove the appearance of a 4K render. Visual Fidelity stays UNSCORED until actual Unity pixels are reviewed.
